items.title: 用餐厅地址理解 Base URL
items.text: 把 AI 工具想成帮你点餐的人。Base URL 就像餐厅地址，告诉工具请求应该送到哪里；它不决定使用哪个模型。

items.title: 去哪里找 Base URL 配置
items.text: Codex：`~/.codex/config.toml`；Claude Code：全局 `~/.claude/settings.json`，项目级 `.claude/settings.json`。如果使用环境变量，再查 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`。

items.title: 本地服务也可能有自己的地址
items.text: 本地模型可能使用 `http://localhost:11434/v1`，表示请求送到当前电脑；它和 OpenRouter 的地址并不相同。

modules.title: 修改地址后要一起检查什么
modules.text: 排查 Base URL 时，依次确认三件事：请求地址正确、服务支持所填模型、API Key 来自该服务。

lessonPractice.title: 配置 OpenRouter 时，哪一项是合适的 Base URL？

options.label: 填写 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`，让工具继续补上本次请求的路径
options.feedback: 对。针对 OpenRouter 这种 OpenAI 兼容的服务，需要包含 /api/v1 路径；但注意并不是所有服务都要写 /v1，例如 Anthropic 的 Base URL 是 `https://api.anthropic.com`，一切以具体服务商文档为准。

options.label: 填写完整的 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
options.feedback: 不对。这包含了具体端点的完整请求路径。Base URL 通常只包含公共前缀，否则工具再次拼接路径时会导致请求地址错误（如双重 completions 路径）。

options.label: 只填写 `https://openrouter.ai`，省略 `/api/v1`
options.feedback: 不对。对于 OpenRouter 这类兼容服务，省略 /api/v1 会导致工具无法匹配正确的接口路径。请务必根据官方文档确定具体前缀，而不是硬套规则。

en.title: Which Base URL is suitable when configuring OpenRouter?

options.label: Use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` and let the tool add the request path
options.feedback: Correct. For OpenAI-compatible services like OpenRouter, the path prefix /api/v1 is needed; however, not all providers use /v1 (e.g. Anthropic uses `https://api.anthropic.com`). Always check the provider's documentation.

options.label: Use the full `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
options.feedback: Incorrect. This includes the full endpoint path. The Base URL should only contain the shared prefix; otherwise, when the tool appends the endpoint path, it will result in a malformed URL.

options.label: Use only `https://openrouter.ai`
options.feedback: This leaves out the path required by the OpenRouter service, so it cannot replace the complete Base URL.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这份配置里的 Base URL 是否应填写 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`，并确认工具会在后面补上具体请求路径；不要把真实密钥写出来。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check whether this configuration should use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` as the Base URL and confirm that the tool adds the request path afterward. Do not print a real key.

learning.assumes: You know that a web address usually has a domain and a path.
learning.outcome: You can find the Base URL in common Codex and Claude Code config files and check the model and request path after changing it.

items.title: Use a restaurant address to understand Base URL
items.text: Imagine the AI tool as someone placing an order for you. The Base URL is like the restaurant's address: it tells the tool where to send the request; it does not choose the model.

items.title: Where can you find the Base URL setting?
items.text: Codex: `~/.codex/config.toml`; Claude Code: global `~/.claude/settings.json`, project-level `.claude/settings.json`. If you use an environment variable, also check `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.

items.title: A local service may use its own address
items.text: A local model may use `http://localhost:11434/v1`, which sends the request to your computer; it is not the same address as OpenRouter.

modules.title: What else should you check after changing the address?
modules.text: When troubleshooting a Base URL, check three things: the request address is correct, the service supports the model, and the API key came from that service.

distinctions.label: URL
distinctions.text: A {c:url} is the complete locator for an internet resource; a {c:base-url} is a common prefix string onto which endpoints and query parameters are appended.

lessonPractice.title: Which Base URL is suitable when configuring OpenRouter?

options.label: Use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` and let the tool add the request path
options.feedback: Correct. The tool starts from this address and adds the request path, such as `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`.

options.label: Use the full `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions`
options.feedback: This already includes the request path. A Base URL usually contains only the shared part, or the tool may add the path again.

options.label: Use only `https://openrouter.ai`
options.feedback: This leaves out the path required by the OpenRouter service, so it cannot replace the complete Base URL.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: Check whether this configuration should use `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` as the Base URL and confirm that the tool adds the request path afterward. Do not print a real key.
